app.name: Istiqamah
app.tagline: Small, steady steps in your deen — together.
app.description: A gentle daily companion for prayer, Quran, adhkar and fasting, with small accountability circles of friends.

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

landing.headline: Steadfast, one day at a time.
landing.body: Track your prayers, Quran, adhkar and fasting with kindness — and walk the path with a few close friends. No rankings, no shame. Just begin again, every day.
landing.point1Body: The five prayers, Quran, morning and evening adhkar, fasting and your own habits.
landing.point2Body: Encourage friends privately. You choose what they can see.
landing.point3Body: Minimal data, no ads, no public leaderboards. Export or delete anytime.
landing.deleted: Your account and all of your data have been deleted. May Allah make it easy for you.

auth.signInBody: Sign in with a link sent to your email, or continue with Google. New here? The same steps create your account.
auth.checkEmailBody: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It expires in 15 minutes. You can close this tab.
auth.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.

onboarding.title: Let's set things up
onboarding.nameHelp: Only people in your circles will see this name.
onboarding.timezoneHelp: Used so your day starts and ends at the right time.
onboarding.locationHelp: We store an approximate location (about 1 km) only to calculate prayer times. You can change or clear it anytime.
onboarding.locationDenied: We couldn't access your location. You can type your city instead.
onboarding.methodHelp: Different organisations use different conventions. If unsure, ask your local masjid which they follow.
onboarding.habitsTitle: What would you like to track?
onboarding.habitsHelp: Start small. You can add, remove or adjust habits anytime.

habits.prayersHelp: Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha
habits.fastingHelp: Including Mondays, Thursdays and the white days

today.allDone: Alhamdulillah — everything is done for today.
today.noneYet: A new day. Start with whatever is closest.
today.someDone: Steady steps. Keep going, one at a time.
today.noLocation: Add your location to see prayer times.
today.timesUnavailable: Prayer times are unavailable right now.

sync.offline: Offline — saved on this device, will sync when you reconnect.
sync.unauthorized: Please sign in again to sync your changes.

settings.title: Settings
settings.exportBody: Download everything we store about you as a JSON file.
settings.deleteBody: Permanently deletes your profile, habits, history, circle memberships and the circles you created. This cannot be undone.

scholar.note: Istiqamah is a tool for consistency, not a source of rulings. It does not issue fatwas. For questions of fiqh, please consult a qualified scholar or your local imam.

placeholder.circles: Small circles with friends — encouragement, nudges and a shared khatm — are coming soon, in shaa Allah.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: No connection right now. Anything you've opened recently is still available.

week.title: This week
week.beginAgain: Missed days are behind you. Every day is a chance to begin again.
week.editHint: Tap a day to correct it (up to 7 days back).

manage.title: Manage habits
manage.intro: Track what helps you right now. Stopping a habit keeps its history.
manage.namePlaceholder: e.g. Give sadaqah, Call my parents
manage.removeConfirm: Remove "{name}" and its history? This cannot be undone.
